Having trouble?

This may be caused by your Twitch session or network configuration.

• Log out of Xtra and sign in again.
• Complete the additional Twitch device/TV authorization step if prompted.
• If you use a VPN, proxy, custom DNS, or network filtering, temporarily disable it and try again.

Then try enabling Live Notifications again.
